name: Westside Pavilion
description: Westside Pavilion is a landmark shopping destination located in West Los Angeles, originally developed as an enclosed regional mall serving the affluent Westside communities. The center has undergone significant transformation in recent years, transitioning from traditional retail to a mixed-use development featuring Google's Los Angeles headquarters alongside remaining retail and dining options.
summary: A transforming West Los Angeles landmark evolving from traditional regional mall to innovative mixed-use campus anchored by Google's offices.
